name: secure-commerce
description: MVP thương mại điện tử modular monolith với Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL và hybrid RSA + AES envelope encryption.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c auto "npm run dev -w @secure-commerce/api" "npm run dev -w @secure-commerce/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @secure-commerce/crypto-envelope && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/domain && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/contracts && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/api && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/web
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:core: npm run build -w @secure-commerce/crypto-envelope && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/domain && node --test scripts/acceptance-core.test.mjs
